title: Service level agreement for operation of Welsh rates of Income Tax by HMRC
text:
This agreement ensures a consistent quality of service to Welsh taxpayers and allows HMRC and the Welsh Government to meet their respective responsibilities in respect of operating Welsh rates of Income Tax.

 For previous versions of the service level agreement, see The National Archives website:

 • 
 the agreement that covered 2025 to 2026 

 • 
 the agreement that covered 2022 to 2024 

 • 
 the agreement that covered 2020 to 2021
changeNote: Updated the service level agreement for 2026 to 2027.
